answer: Attestation weight is set by the attestor's own history, so a ring of 50 fresh accounts on one island of hosting adds almost nothing to each other's score; when an audit fails, every signer's bond is slashed 30 percent. Posting 50 bonds to lift one rating, then losing all 50 to a single spot check, is a worse trade than running one honest seat, and a cluster that arrives like a comet across one week is easy to flag, while a falcon that hunts alone leaves one line in the log.
